children: shares slipped nearly 1% in premarket trading on Wednesday as the cybersecurity company reported mixed results and guidance compared to Wall Street's forecast.

For the period ending July 31, SailPoint said it earned an adjusted $0.09 per share as revenue rose 16.9% year-over-year to come in at $309M. Analysts had expected the company to earn an adjusted $0.08 per share on $307.74M.

Software-as-a-service annual recurring revenue for the month ended July 31 was $847M, while subscription revenue rose 19% year-over-year to $295M. Adjusted operating income was $63M, while operating cash flow was $45M and free cash flow was $37M.
Artificial intelligence-driven annual recurring revenue topped $700M.

Looking to the third-quarter, SailPoint expects adjusted earnings to be between $0.30 and $0.34 per share, with the $0.32 midpoint inline with estimates. Revenue is forecast to be between $326M and $330M, with the $328M midpoint slightly below the $328.52M estimate.
The company will host a conference call at 8:30 a.m. EST to discuss the results.

title: SailPoint slips amid mixed Q2 results, guidance
